minutes.headline: Zoning board granted a roof-height special permit at 17 Ruth Street and a solar array permit at 11 Beach View Road.
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard two special permit applications. One was a roof height exception for a home addition at 17 Ruth Street, justified by future solar panels. The other was a continued hearing on a ground-mounted solar array at 11 Beach View Road with a reduced setback. Both appear to have been granted with standard conditions, but vote counts are not clearly in the captions.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals granted a special permit for a roof height exception for a home addition at 17 Ruth Street; the vote count was not audible.
The board attached standard conditions, including a 20-day appeal period, recording at the Registry of Deeds, and use within two years.
After a recess, the board granted a special permit for a ground-mounted solar array at 11 Beach View Road at a continued hearing; the vote count was not audible.
No public comment appears in the captions for either hearing.

why_it_matters: These are individual property permits, so they touch the neighbors' view, shading and screening more than any town tax or service, and the 20-day appeal period is the window in which an abutter could challenge them.
watch_next: The 20-day appeal period on each permit, and the filing of each decision with the town clerk within 14 days.
